sql: SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('decision_id',d.id,'replay_attempt_id',d.replay_attempt_id,'operation',d.delivery_operation_id,'audit',(SELECT count(*) FROM audit_event a WHERE a.object_id=d.delivery_operation_id AND a.action='DELIVERY_CREDENTIAL_REPLAY_CONTAINMENT_PENDING' AND a.after_state->>'replayAttemptId'=d.replay_attempt_id::text),'evidence',(SELECT count(*) FROM evidence e WHERE e.source_id=d.delivery_operation_id AND e.evidence_type='DELIVERY_CREDENTIAL_REPLAY' AND e.metadata->>'decision'='CONTAINMENT_PENDING' AND e.metadata->>'replayAttemptId'=d.replay_attempt_id::text),'outbox',(SELECT count(*) FROM outbox_event o WHERE o.aggregate_id=d.delivery_operation_id AND o.event_type='DatasetCredentialReplayContainmentPending' AND o.payload->>'replayAttemptId'=d.replay_attempt_id::text)) ORDER BY d.created_at),'[]')::text FROM delivery_credential_replay_decision d WHERE d.decision='CONTAINMENT_PENDING' AND d.delivery_operation_id IN ('e829b8ce-347b-438a-b5b9-d138c1c65124','c5231f47-1f0e-4950-b9c8-5fe82bdb43fe');
